youtube_description:
Join Vivek Ramaswamy as he fearlessly takes on tough questions in a captivating interview on CNN's State of the Union with Dana Bash. In this thought-provoking conversation, Vivek shares his unique perspectives and stands firm in his commitment to uphold American values.

Vivek announces his intention to pardon Donald Trump on day one of his presidency. He goes on to shed light on the behind-the-scenes activities involving Biden, Garland, and Jack Smith, suggesting that political opponents should not be targeted by the federal police state.

During the interview, Vivek enlightens Dana Bash about the fact that anyone can indict a ham sandwich, highlighting the importance of ensuring that the people, not the federal police state, have the power to choose their leaders. He further emphasizes that all citizens should be held to the same standard when it comes to the law, promoting fairness and equality.

Vivek doesn't shy away from holding the media accountable, calling out their failure to provide unbiased coverage. He challenges the media's perceived bias, suggesting that if a Republican were in the White House, the media's approach would likely be different. His stance on media accountability resonates with those who value objective journalism and transparency.

Don't miss this captivating interview as Vivek Ramaswamy fearlessly defends American values, challenges the status quo, and champions the power of the people. Tune in and witness his unwavering commitment to a fair and just society.
